name: historical-bird-plates
title: Historical bird plates: modern identifications
description: Plate-by-plate modern identifications of historical bird folios, with eBird, Wikidata, GBIF, Avibase and BirdNET identifiers, and each plate's engraved credit line.

resources.name: havell-plates
resources.title: Audubon, The Birds of America (Havell edition): plates

fields.name: plate
fields.description: Havell plate number, 1–435.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Audubon's title for the plate, as audubon.org gives it.

fields.name: legend
fields.description: The legend lines engraved under the title (figure key, plant), separated by ' | '.

fields.name: imprint
fields.description: The plate's credit lines, as engraved, with spacing, initials and the mark after an abbreviation written by one convention (see the README): the left corner, then the centre, then the right corner, each top to bottom, joined with " | ". They name who drew, lithographed or engraved the plate and who printed it. Empty where none can be read, with the reason in notes.

fields.name: image_url
fields.description: The plate's image on audubon.org (not open-licensed; see havell/README.md).

fields.name: sheet_asset
fields.description: The full plate in the havell-v2 release.

fields.name: crop_asset
fields.description: The plate with its lettering trimmed, in the havell-v2 release.

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Anything about the plate.

resources.name: havell-species
resources.title: Audubon, The Birds of America (Havell edition): identifications

fields.name: plate
fields.description: The plate's number in its folio's own numbering.

fields.name: figure
fields.description: On a sheet with several species, this species' figure key as printed (e.g. '2. Tree Sparrow.').

fields.name: printed_name
fields.description: The name the folio prints for this bird.

fields.name: printed_latin
fields.description: The Latin name the folio prints, as printed.

fields.name: scientific
fields.description: Modern scientific name, in the taxonomy named in `taxonomy`. Empty when unresolved.

fields.name: common
fields.description: Modern English name, in the taxonomy named in `taxonomy`.

fields.name: ebird_code
fields.description: eBird species code in that taxonomy version.

fields.name: taxonomy
fields.description: The taxonomy `scientific`, `common` and `ebird_code` come from, e.g. 'eBird/Clements 2025'.

fields.name: wikidata
fields.description: Wikidata item of the species: the species-rank item Wikipedia uses (see tools/identify.py). Empty when Wikidata has no species item.

fields.name: gbif
fields.description: GBIF backbone taxon key, from that Wikidata item (P846).

fields.name: avibase
fields.description: Avibase concept ID, from that Wikidata item (P2026).

fields.name: birdnet_label
fields.description: The species' label in BirdNET GLOBAL 6K V2.4, verbatim (Sci_Common). Empty when BirdNET has no such class.

fields.name: form
fields.description: Blank for the species itself; subspecies, variant, or pre-split (the plate predates a split and stands for a parent species).

fields.name: confidence
fields.description: high: certain. judged: a considered call, reason given. medium/low: open. none: not identified.

fields.name: caption_checked
fields.description: yes: the identification was checked by eye against the engraved caption on the scanned leaf.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Why this identification, or why none.

fields.name: sources
fields.description: Where the identification comes from.
